children: China is likely to face deflationary risks in 2027 if oil prices normalize, according to Citi analysts in a research note. The country's consumer-price index inflation moderated in October, missing market expectations, the bank says. "We believe risks could remain tilted to the upside for producer price index but to the downside to consumer price index in the near-term despite elevated uncertainties around oil price and the Middle East situation," the bank says. This may increase the rise of "bad inflation" in the near term, they note. Downstream sectors could be squeezed by both higher input prices and sluggish end demand at the same time, they note. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
